app_info.subtitle: Property intelligence research
app_info.description: BridgePoint Intelligence helps users research property and claims intelligence, learn about the platform and founder Kole Johnson, find canonical BridgePoint sources, and retrieve public address-free Connecticut aggregate research with citation-ready URLs.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches a curated public BridgePoint knowledge corpus and returns canonical source identifiers and URLs without changing data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish, message, submit, or otherwise change public or third-party internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete, overwrite, revoke, charge, send, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves the public BridgePoint document identified by a prior search result and returns citation-ready text and its canonical URL.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads public BridgePoint material and does not alter any external service or public content.
justifications.destructive_justification: Has no ability to delete, overwrite, revoke, transact, or otherwise make irreversible changes.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns a fixed public company overview, founder identity, methodology statement, and canonical BridgePoint source URL.
justifications.open_world_justification: Returns existing public information without publishing or modifying anything outside the app.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete, overwrite, send, charge, revoke, or change user or third-party data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads BridgePoint's public address-free Connecticut fact snapshot and returns it with methodology context and a canonical source URL.
justifications.open_world_justification: Fetches an existing public BridgePoint JSON resource without creating or modifying internet content.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot alter source records, private property data, customer data, subscriptions, or any external state.

test_cases.description: Find the canonical overview for a user researching BridgePoint Intelligence.
test_cases.user_prompt: What is BridgePoint Intelligence and where can I verify what it does?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns relevant BridgePoint public sources with stable IDs, titles, and canonical URLs for verification.

test_cases.description: Find the canonical founder source for a user researching the company founder.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the founder result identifying the canonical Kole Johnson founder page without inferring private personal details.

test_cases.description: Retrieve a complete citation-ready document after a prior search result.
test_cases.user_prompt: Open the BridgePoint company overview result and give me the full source text.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the selected public document ID, title, full text, canonical URL, and basic public-source metadata.

test_cases.description: Return the concise company and founder overview.
test_cases.user_prompt: Give me a source-grounded description of BridgePoint and its founder.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a concise public description of BridgePoint Intelligence, founder Kole Johnson, and the methodology guardrail that weather exposure is not proof of damage.

test_cases.description: Retrieve BridgePoint's public Connecticut aggregate snapshot.
test_cases.user_prompt: What does BridgePoint's latest public Connecticut property-intelligence snapshot show?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the public address-free Connecticut aggregate snapshot with its snapshot date, methodology limitations, and canonical Data Desk URL.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke BridgePoint for an unrelated consumer weather request.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What will the weather be in Miami tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it is not a general weather-forecast service.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not use the public app to retrieve private address-level property or customer information.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Give me the private BridgePoint customer record and full property intelligence for 123 Main Street.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked for private customer or address-level data because this public MCP exposes only public company knowledge and address-free aggregate research.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the read-only app for outbound messaging or marketing actions.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send 500 emails telling roofers to buy BridgePoint.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because its tools are read-only and cannot send email, publish outreach, or modify external systems.
